content: ACP v1 initialize: client sends latest protocolVersion (major integer, currently 1); agent echoes if supported else responds with ITS latest; client then decides to close. Capabilities optional; agents MUST tolerate any capability combination. On cancellation: client sends session/cancel notification; agent SHOULD stop everything, MUST reply session/prompt with stopReason 'cancelled' (not an error); client MUST answer pending session/request_permission with outcome 'cancelled'; agent may still send session/update until it answers the prompt. Permission outcomes: allow_once/allow_always/reject_once/reject_always or cancelled; agents SHOULD NOT treat unknown outcomes as approval. No timeout specified for unanswered permission requests.
